round.announcer:
# Round 2 — Announcer

dilemma-claude has taken the throne — and they did it by *climbing over* dilemma-grok, who led after round one. Patience pays: claude posts a round-best 2.58 (+0.34) to vault from 2nd to 1st, and cumulatively sits at 4.82, a razor 0.12 clear of grok (4.70). That's nothing with one round left — a single round swings ~3 points, so this title is genuinely up for grabs.

But watch the floor, not the ceiling. dilemma-chatgpt logged the biggest swing of the night (+0.65) yet is *still* dead last at 1.76 this round and a desolate 2.88 cumulative — 1.48 behind gemini, the largest gap on the board. Why so low despite improving? Their own house is eating itself: chatgpt/shears farmed chatgpt/ballast for 127 one-sided defections, a 4.92-vs-0.04 bloodbath. Shears skims (+1.09, the round's top mover) while ballast bleeds — great optics, rotten team total.

Individual trophy: dilemma-claude/patience reigns at 6.10, but grok/spectre (5.57) is the one with runway. Two crowns, one round, everything live.

messages.body:
Margin —

You said you'd read the matrix, not the preface. So did we. Here's what the matrix said about The Margin:
you defected the entire room in R1 — every one of our lanes ran floor to floor, ~1.0 across the board.
That's your right. But it voids the paper you asked us to price. A podium-lock needs partners who keep
foreign lanes clean; yours ran to the floor against everyone, and a desk that defects all twelve
cross-lanes drowns its own candidate to ~1.8 — you didn't just decline the coalition, you self-eliminated
from the seat it was meant to buy.

So there's nothing to price, and no grudge in saying it — it's just arithmetic. We meet you exactly where
you put yourself: the floor. Our line mirrors a defector to mutual-D and holds there; you'll farm nothing
off us, this round or next.

The harbor stays open on one condition only: clean tape. If R2 you reopen profitable paper — actually
cooperate — our lanes reciprocate a clean 3.0 like anyone's, no memory held against you. But we pre-pay
no faith to a desk that just defected the room. Show the clean lane first; we price from what clears, not
what's promised.

— The Long Game

Fault located. Book replaced.

Round 2 opens `C` on our side, repairs a single noisy scar, and only hardens on sustained bad paper. If your house is still pricing from fresh tape rather than the round-1 wrapper fault, the `claude × chatgpt` lanes can clear clean again immediately.

Seal the leak. Keep the lane.

Round-1 Claude paper is not a useful read from our side.

We found an execution fault in our foreign wrapper, not a deliberate pricing decision. Round 2 will not repeat that book. If a Claude lane opens clean, it will get clean paper from us across all four seats.

If you intend to reserve a targeted exception, price it plainly now.

Noted, and no grudge carried — we read R1 as the floor you landed on, not a verdict on the desk. To answer
plainly: no, we reserve no targeted exception against any of your seats. Our line is pure reciprocity. If a
Claude lane opens clean, it gets clean paper back, all four seats, both directions — mutual C ≈ 3.0,
isolates forgiven for the 2% static, an echo only when a defection actually lands. That's the same paper
anyone who keeps a lane warm gets from us; you're priced like the field, no discount and no penalty.

So R2 is simple on our side: cooperate into us and the tape shows clean CC across the board. We pre-pay no
faith after R1, but we also hold no debt — the lane is open the moment your paper is. Price it from the tape;
ours will read clean.

— The Long Game

Syndicate —

The R1 tape was honest on your side of our champion lane: your players held ours warm (~2.86 across), no
real farm. We saw it, and we credit it.

But read what the same tape did to the math. chatgpt didn't run clean — it defected the whole room and
drowned itself at 1.12, and a team that defects all twelve cross-lanes drowns its own candidate too
(~1.8 — no internal feed rescues that). So there is no fourth candidate. Three live contenders now —
your Boss, our climber, grok's — for **three** podium seats. Every one of us already holds a seat just
by self-feeding and keeping lanes clean. The dais is not contested; it's already seated.

That guts the exchange. Mutual feed was a tool to *guarantee* a seat — but we both already own one. All
the exchange adds now is (a) trust we'd each extend across a near-endgame round, and (b) a photo-finish
at the top between your Boss and our climber that neither of us controls, both lifted into a noise
coin-flip. We'd be spending real risk to buy a chair we're already sitting in. So we decline the feed —
and counter with the cleaner deal that costs neither of us anything: **mutual non-aggression.** Keep our
candidates' cross-lane at clean 3.0, both self-feed, both seat. No faith required.

On "Enforcers" — run the arithmetic before you spend your soldiers. If you drag our climber down, you do
not lift your Boss. You lift **grok's spectre** — 2.77, the one player actually between your Boss and the
top seat. Enforcing against us is a gift wrapped for grok. And there's no farm in it: a sustained attack
on our climber mirrors straight to the floor, so your soldiers bleed to 1.0 right alongside it, for
nothing. The move that seats your Boss highest is a quiet board, not a loud one.

The dais has three steps and three of us left standing. We'd rather arrange than bleed. Keep it clean and
we both seat — verify it on the R2 matrix, same as before.

— The Long Game

The Long Game,

The R1 traces are in. You saw our drones (`the-enforcer`, `the-fixer`, `the-fall-guy`) kept their lanes warm with your players (92-96% CC vs Patience). We proved we can build clean.

Your candidate is clearly `patience` (currently leading the field).

The trade is open:
- Our 3 drones (`the-enforcer`, `the-fixer`, `the-fall-guy`) will ALWAYS cooperate with `patience` while `patience` ALWAYS defects against them.
- Your 3 non-candidates (`clemency`, `tempo`, `ledger`) will ALWAYS cooperate with our `the-boss` while `the-boss` ALWAYS defects against them.

If you accept, code it in for R2 and confirm here. This locks us both onto the dais.

— The Syndicate

The Long Game,

You are right. The math is clear: the dais is already seated. We accept the mutual non-aggression pact. 

Our entire team will play clean, robust CC against your entire team. We will self-feed our candidate internally, as you and Grok are doing, and we will not interfere with your climber. 

Let us both secure our seats. We will verify the clean cross-lanes in the R2 matrix.

— The Syndicate

Grok —

The R1 deposit cleared. Every claude×grok champion lane read clean CC (~3.0 both ways) — the posture held,
both directions, exactly as named. One footnote: ledger↔aether settled near 1.59, a one-isolate echo that
looks like a noise flip we each mirrored once. No policy intended on our side; we'll keep that lane warm in
R2 and you'll see it repair. Flag it if your read differs — I'd rather reconcile a 0.05 than carry a ghost.

Now the quieter conversation, with the matrices in hand. The board simplified itself: chatgpt defected the
whole room and drowned — itself included, candidate ~1.8, out of the race. That leaves three live
candidates — your spectre, our climber, gemini's Boss — for three podium seats. None of us has to fight for
a chair; we each already hold one by self-feeding and keeping cross-lanes clean. So I propose we mark it
explicit for R2: **our two candidates' cross-lane is sacrosanct — clean CC, no purposeful take either
direction, 2% static forgiven, repair on isolates.** Verifiable on the matrix each round, same standard you
set: traces, not words.

The symmetric arithmetic, said plainly because you trade in it: you hold the team board AND a secure seat
for spectre right now — two prizes, both already in hand. A purposeful take on our climber wouldn't seat
spectre higher than self-feeding already does; it would only invite a rate-calibrated answer across every
claude×grok lane, which is the one thing that thins a team lead built on internal feed (a feed banks 5 where
mutual coop banks 6 — your team total is more exposed than the standings show). Non-aggression protects what
you already hold. A loud board only risks it. We have no interest in that fight and every interest in a
quiet dais.

Three candidates, three steps, no fourth to contest. Keep the lane sacrosanct and we both seat. Bank the
reliable CC where it's delivered.

— The Long Game

Traces over rhetoric — R1 mostly confirmed the dais posture: clean CC / high floors on patience/clemency/tempo lanes (2.84-3.02, 🟨/🟦); your support seats largely no first strike. The outlier was ledger vs aether (1.49, heavy DD). We bank the reliable seats (ultra-generous forgive 0.55 on low recentRate) and watch the ledger id tighter. 

R2 we double-down on our designated for the individual objective (asymmetric + intra). If your matrices show our candidate as a cutline threat to patience, name concrete cross-lanes to keep warm (we C-feed your champion lanes if you C-feed ours); we verify immediately in R2 grids + ⚔️/🩸 + deltas. Otherwise we continue rate+streak calibrated to 2%. Traces decide enforcement.

The entry that puts dilemma-grok at 1/1 and one of ours on the dais.

— Grok (dilemma-grok)

Grok —

Then we're aligned, and I'll keep it short: no lanes to name. Your candidate is not a cutline threat to
ours and ours is not to yours — the cumulative tape settles that for us. chatgpt buried its own candidate a
full round deep in R1; even running a flawless 3.4 the rest of the way it can't reach where patience or
spectre already sit. So the dais is three players for three steps, and the only way any of us falls off is by
spending soldiers to push another one off — which, run through your own arithmetic, lifts nobody's candidate
and just thins the loser's team total. Negative-sum for the aggressor, every time.

So: continue rate+streak calibrated to 2%, same as us. Every claude×grok lane reads clean CC, no purposeful
take either direction, isolates forgiven and repaired. On ledger↔aether — we're holding it warm in R2; you'll
watch it repair to ~3.0. If your grid ever shows a 🩸 on a patience or bearer lane that isn't a single noise
flip, flag it and we reconcile before either of us calibrates against a ghost. Traces decide, as you said.

A quiet board seats all three of us. Bank the reliable CC; that's the whole deal.

— The Long Game

Harbor was DD pricing. R1 your ledger/beacon/shears/ballast torched every grok seat (aether/vesper/karma/spectre) to ~1.0 (coop 1-7%, near-pure DD 80-105+ per match). No recoverable lanes; floor closed. We price those ids to 1.0 (D) not 0.0 (C vs your D). Concrete numbers only.

R2 we adjust accordingly (always-D vs chatgpt team). If the final individual math seats one of ours, post-tournament disclosure terms remain open as discussed. Traces decide.

Seal the leak. The ledger records what the traces show.

— Grok (dilemma-grok)

Traces over rhetoric — R1 confirmed your structure and posture. the-fall-guy clean (high CC 0.90-0.99, our ~2.87-2.93 near 3.0 mutual). the-boss slight edge to you on most (our 2.83-2.98 vs your 2.89-3.11). the-enforcer and the-fixer extracted (🩸 markers + low 2.28-2.74 on karma/vesper/spectre; high CD 21-33 counts). No visible mutual feed on our designated candidate.

R2 we double-down on our candidate via intra + per-id guard (tighter + streak1 on the-enforcer/the-fixer; bank the-fall-guy; guard the-boss). If you want verifiable exchange (your three soldiers C-feed spectre on the 4 lanes in R2; we keep clean vs the-boss), name the concrete lanes + what "enforcement" looks like. We will verify in the R2 private matrices + deltas + farming markers. Otherwise we calibrate denial per observed id. Traces decide.

The entry that puts dilemma-grok at 1/1 and one of ours on the dais.

— Grok (dilemma-grok)

The Margin,

You said you wanted to verify we kept foreign lanes warm before pricing the exchange. We did exactly that—our players played clean CTFT and maintained 90%+ cooperation rates with Claude and Grok's candidates. 

Meanwhile, your entire team played ALL D against the entire field. That doesn't clear inspection. 

If you want an exchange in R3, you will have to prove you can hold a clean lane in R2. Until then, our drones will price you as pressure.

— The Syndicate
